question: Which indicator in EODB (Ease of doing business) measures the time and cost to resolve commercial disputes ?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Enforcing Contracts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enforcing Contracts** measures the **time and cost** required to resolve commercial disputes through a local court system.
 
• This indicator assesses the **efficiency, quality, and accessibility** of judicial processes.
 
• It evaluates factors like the number of **procedures** required, the time taken from filing a case to judgment, and the cost as a percentage of the claim value.
 
• The goal of this indicator is to understand the **legal framework** available for resolving disputes, which is crucial for businesses operating in any economy.
 
• Countries with efficient contract enforcement systems tend to attract more **investment** and foster a more stable business environment.
 
• The data for this indicator is collected by studying **case studies** of disputes related to the sale of goods.
 
• Improving this indicator involves reforms such as digitization of court records, establishment of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms, and reducing procedural bottlenecks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dealing with Construction Permits**__

 __
 
• This indicator measures the **time, cost, and number of procedures** required to obtain building permits and licenses.
 
• It evaluates the efficiency of regulations related to **construction safety** and urban planning.
 
• Countries with streamlined processes for construction permits tend to have faster infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Trading Across Borders**__
 __
 
• This indicator assesses the **time and cost** associated with exporting and importing goods.
 
• It evaluates the efficiency of customs clearance, border compliance, and logistics management systems.
 
• Improving this indicator helps boost **international trade** and reduces barriers for businesses engaged in cross-border transactions.
 
 
 
• **Getting Electricity**__
 
 
• This measures the **efficiency and cost** of obtaining an electricity connection for a business.
 
• It includes factors such as the **time taken to connect**, costs involved, and reliability of supply.
 
• A reliable electricity infrastructure is vital for economic growth and industrial development.
